'''Valjak''' was a [[Tasari]] male and member of the secret order known as [[Kiana]]. Members of the Kiana were dedicated to fight against the blood cults that hid among Tasari society. Valjak operated as a guide to off-worlders to cover his activities and to earn a living. Educated at [[Tasariq University]], he had an understanding of off-world culture but tended to be more pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] as he saw them as a potential ally in the fight against the blood cults. Valjak wore a bracer on his right arm inset with a [[citrine crystal]], and a bracer on his left inset with an [[azurite crystal]]. The Tasari also wore a headband with a [[jasper crystal]] installed, and a [[bloodstone crystal]] mounted on the pommel of his [[Sword/Legends|sword]].<ref name="J15" />
